blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewee: Bobby Hutcherson (January 27, 1941 – August 15, 2016) with his wife Rosemary Hutcherson Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 60 pp.
This is the Smithsonian NEA Jazz Oral History interview with Bobby Hutcherson in his home in Montero, California. Good afternoon, Bobby.

It’s indeed a pleasure to be here, be in your home and be able to talk to you, one of my heroes for so many years, a fellow Californian. If we could just start by you stating your full name at birth and your birth place and birth date, please.
